description: List standards whose last_verified date is older than N days (default 30), optionally filtered by lifecycle step. Returns { days, cutoff, total_standards, oldest_verified, newest_verified, records: [{ id, name, step, last_verified, freshness, url }] }. Use stale to audit verification freshness; use changes to inspect actual specification edits since a date.

days.description: return standards whose last_verified date is older than this many days (default 30)

step.description: optional lifecycle step filter (discover, identify, permit, read, act, coordinate, pay, present, account)

name: stale
